jcr:title: Stryker recognized by Gartner as a top 25 healthcare supply chain leader

text.text:
Stryker has been recognized by Gartner and listed as a top 25 Healthcare Supply Chain company for the first time. Factors that lifted Stryker eight spots from 2016 include an organizational redesign, enterprise resource planning consolidations, focused customer programs and a focused global supply chain academy.

“Stryker’s Team is very excited to be recognized by Gartner, our supply chain peers and customers for our advancements in supply chain excellence,” said Tamara Sniffen, Vice President, Supply Chain Operations. “We have been strategically reshaping our supply chain organization, processes and systems on a global scale over the past several years. We are on a journey with many exciting transformational opportunities ahead. We appreciate the collaboration with our customers and strategic partners that have helped Stryker get this far in delivering on our mission to make healthcare better.”

Gartner’s annual list recognizes healthcare manufacturers, providers, distributors and retailers that demonstrate leadership in improving human life at sustainable costs.
